name: intelligent-ui
description: Core runtime, host adapter layer, and agent adapters for Intelligent UI.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @intelligent-ui/adapter && npm run build -w @intelligent-ui/dsh && npm run build -w @intelligent-ui/react && npm run build -w @intelligent-ui/ai-sdk && npm run build -w @intelligent-ui/mcp-apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @intelligent-ui/core && npm run typecheck -w @intelligent-ui/adapter && npm run typecheck -w @intelligent-ui/dsh && npm run typecheck -w @intelligent-ui/react && npm run typecheck -w @intelligent-ui/ai-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @intelligent-ui/mcp-apps
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.bench:selfcheck: npm run build:core && node bench/run.mjs --provider mock --mode fence --out bench/results/selfcheck.json
